verdict.rationale: Runloop's core product is isolated sandbox environments (Devboxes) for AI agents. Snapshots support rollback and branching from a known-good state, egress network policies limit outbound access, and Agent Gateways and MCP Hub keep credentials out of the sandbox. Together these let agents test in a throwaway environment rather than production. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement on separating sandboxes from production data or systems, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation guarantees.
